name: Gear Train
desc: A machine-drawing plate of a working epicyclic reduction unit — sun, orbiting planets and a fixed internal ring whose teeth genuinely mesh, a compound spur chain wandering off through the coupling, dash-dot centrelines and chain-line pitch circles, and a title block whose shaft-speed readout shifts ratio every section.

energy.doc: drive speed + line weight + inspection-wash glow + plate drift

scale.doc: gear module — 2.2 fills the frame with the ring gear

density.doc: how many gears in the spur chain (3..11)

hue.doc: plate tint (film/xray styles); other styles are fixed inks

teeth.doc: spur-chain tooth counts — 0 coarse/few teeth, 1 fine/many

anno.doc: annotation density: pitch circles, centrelines, callouts, title block

style.doc: aesthetic: toned drafting film / prussian cyanotype / aged engraved plate / translucent additive x-ray / abstracted pitch-circle-and-vector schematic

alpha.doc: ink opacity over the plate ground
